headline: Indonesia’s Prabowo announces export controls for coal, palm oil
summary: Indonesian President Prabowo announced export controls for coal and palm oil, with future natural resource sales to go through state-owned enterprises. The aim is to boost tax revenues amid economic headwinds from the Middle East war.
why: Indonesia is a leading global exporter of thermal coal and palm oil, so export rules directly affect global energy and edible oil supply.
why_moved: Export controls on two major Indonesian commodities would tighten supply channels to global buyers. The move is framed as a way to raise tax revenue during regional economic pressure.
